summary: Harden repository routing and local-only ticket creation

delivery.outcome: Repository discovery stops at Git boundaries, rejects configured GitHub origin mismatches, and ticket-triggered sync remains exact and fail-closed.
nonGoals: No remote issue mutation during validation
No changes to ticket-radar or other parallel worktrees
No changes to GitHub trust policy or comment transport

architecture.decision: Use read-only Git root/origin probes at auto-discovery and pass exact ticket and sprint filters to the existing protected sync path; keep local creation independent from external publication unless --sync is explicit.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; retain local stores and do not alter remote issues.

commands: uv run ruff check planfile/project_paths.py planfile/cli/groups/ticket/commands.py tests/test_repository_routing.py
